manaNeeded: {0} plus the mana cost of the creature in your hand
easyPrerequisites: Werefox Bodyguard must be exiled by Faceless Butcher, and Glorious Protector must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Glorious Protector for its mana cost.
When Glorious Protector enters, it exiles Faceless Butcher until Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Glorious Protector's ETB.
When Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield, Werefox Bodyguard is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Werefox Bodyguard enters, it exiles Glorious Protector until Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Werefox Bodyguard's ETB.
When Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield, Faceless Butcher is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, it exiles Werefox Bodyguard until Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Faceless Butcher's ETB.
When Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield, Glorious Protector is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
